results.title: Forced-KO recovery resumes productive farming
results.expectation: Per seed: an initial Hero KO, a recovery event restoring every deployed Hero to its event-time max HP, the same region/stage/wave across the recovery transition, then ≥20 consecutive ordinary clears with no additional Hero KO, gap, ambiguous transition or deadlock. The boss is held (no summon) so ordinary farming continues at readiness. Timeout short of 20 without a failure is INCONCLUSIVE.
unknowns: recovery behaviour after a boss is summoned (not exercised under hold policy)

assumptions.name: hostile-hit cap
assumptions.statement: In continuous combat an enemy hit on a Hero applies at most max(1, floor(maxHP × fraction[tier])) HP, with fractions fodder/routine 0.02, hard 0.08, elite 0.12, boss 0.18. Applied HP may be lower than the bound (raw below bound or HP floor).
assumptions.basis: transcribed from candidate web-runner/src/core/routineEnemyScaling.mjs and web-runner/modules/heroCommands.mjs; not imported

assumptions.name: cap tier input
assumptions.statement: The cap tier is the EnemyData row tier looked up by enemy name (combatTier, then routineTier, default routine), not the spawned actor tier.
assumptions.basis: code reading of heroCommands.mjs applyDamage; the harness logs both tiers so disagreement stays visible

assumptions.name: ordinary wave-clear respite
assumptions.statement: Each living Hero below max HP gains min(maxHP, hp + ceil(0.15 × maxHP)) − hp when an ordinary wave clears.

assumptions.name: defeat recovery
assumptions.statement: Ordinary-defeat and boss-timeout recovery restore every deployed Hero to full max HP.

assumptions.name: boss-clear restore
assumptions.statement: Boss victory restores every Hero to full HP. The runtime does not log this restore, so the model applies it at the observed boss-clear poll and accepts either pre- or post-restore HP for the next Hero event in that poll window.
assumptions.basis: player-living-guide.md; unlogged HP assignment observed by code reading

assumptions.name: HP continuity
assumptions.statement: Current HP changes only through logged damage, heal and recovery events, A5, and max-HP decreases that clamp current HP. Max-HP increases (level-up, gear) do not change current HP.

assumptions.name: boss timer
assumptions.statement: A boss attempt times out once 18 game seconds elapse with the boss alive; a timeout records elapsed ≥ 18.

assumptions.name: enemy targeting
assumptions.statement: Enemy target choice reads Hero HP only through living/KO status (provoke, preferred, stable nearest).
assumptions.basis: code reading of selectContinuousEnemyTarget in web-runner/src/core/arenaCombat.mjs

assumptions.name: Hero HP guards
assumptions.statement: Unlocked Hero skills whose conditions read Hero HP ratios are listed in HP_GUARDS; other unlocked skills do not read Hero HP.
assumptions.basis: transcribed from heroDefinitions.mjs condition labels and unlock levels

assumptions.name: cadence unknown
assumptions.statement: Hits per wave are not modeled from mechanics. The survival envelope sweeps a declared integer range instead of fitting one value.

assumptions.name: envelope worst case
assumptions.statement: For the survival envelope every hit applies the A1 bound at opening max HP, and max HP stays constant.
